variants.headline: Fair treatment belongs to solidarity
variants.body: Food is short in {colony}, and people are hungry. Working households need enough to eat; a debate cannot fill that need. Solidarity means fairness to {target}.

variants.headline: Support before the rush to blame
variants.body: Residents are hungry because food is insufficient in {colony}. Solidarity starts with treating enough to eat as a common need. Solidarity means fairness to {target}.

variants.headline: Hunger must not excuse an unfair verdict
variants.body: There is too little food in {colony}, and people are hungry. Enough to eat is a basic condition of a decent life. Solidarity means fairness to {target}.
